events.content: The POS is an iPad app written in Swift
Store orders in a central Firebase Firestore database
Taking orders must keep working when the restaurant's internet is down
Take card payments with Square terminals
Print kitchen tickets on Epson thermal printers over the local network
Store orders on the device in SQLite and sync them to Postgres in the cloud
events.rationale: Firestore offline mode lost orders during long outages
